text:
marco: FYI: Were changing the default telemetry posture for NEW Private/VPC installers to OFF starting 2026-04-02 00:00 UTC. This only affects new private installs and on-prem packages, not Hosted API.

anya: Is this a policy or a product flag change?

marco: Both. Product will ship Agent 2.2 and control plane 2.5 with telemetry=false as the default. Policy team updated the privacy checklist to require explicit opt-in for data sharing.

kyle_ops: How will existing customers be handled? I assume no silent changes.

marco: Correct. Existing installs remain unchanged for 120 days. Well notify admins and provide a CLI + console opt-in flow. No automatic flips.

legal-bot: Legal note: notification must include a short summary of telemetry types (metrics, anonymized perf traces, no raw customer requests) and retention period (90 days), plus a link to the consent UI.

marco: Good call. Well include that in the email template.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout job: onprem-default-telemetry-toggle v1.0 queued for 2026-04-02 00:00 UTC. Change window: 25m. CI link: https://ci.internal/builds/55821

anya: Ops ask: will debug/support bundles still be generated for high-sev incidents? We need something for root cause analysis.

marco: Support bundles still exist but are redacted by default. For unredacted bundles, customers must grant temporary access via the new consent handshake; well document the manual override flow in the runbook.

kyle_ops: Also we need a metric to track opt-in rate and any unexpected agent disconnects post-rollout. Ill add monitors to infra.

marco: Please add a heartbeat SLO monitor and an opt-in telemetry counter. Watch first 72h closely.

sasha: Can we get a short GTM-friendly blurb for sales and marketplace listing? Partners will ask.

marco: Ill post a 2-line summary in #product-commms in 30m and attach the FAQ.

anya: Where will the migration guide live?

marco: Internal runbooks: docs/internal/onprem-telemetry-opt-in.md and docs/internal/onprem-telemetry-rollback.md created. Public KB: docs/public/onprem-telemetry.md (will go live with the announcement).

legal-bot: Approved the notice language with minor edits. Add the console banner copy: "Telemetry is disabled by default for new private installs. Enable to share anonymized usage metrics with Redwood to improve reliability."

marco: Final checklist: 1) publish migration guide, 2) send targeted emails to active private customers Tue 12:00 PT, 3) console banner + opt-in button, 4) update marketplace entries. If anyone needs to edit templates, do it before EOD today.

kyle_ops: Ill run a dry deployment in staging tonight.

anya: Thanks team. Short sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to sign off.

sasha: :rocket:
